faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: The last date to receive the filled-up application form is 17th August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated authority by this date.

faq.question: Q2. What are the educational qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.E./M.Tech. or equivalent degree in Electrical Engineering/Electrical and Electronics Engineering with a valid GATE score, or a B.E./B.Tech. or equivalent degree in the same fields with a valid GATE score.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position is 35 years as of the application closing date. Age relaxation is applicable for reserved categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000/- per month for the first two years (JRF) and Rs. 42,000/- per month for the third year (SRF).

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at NIT Silchar?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out, and send it along with necessary documents via post to the P.I.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of selection for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves submitting applications with CV and documents. Shortlisted candidates will be notified about the date, time, and venue for further steps.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job opportunity at the National Institute of Technology Silchar.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of NIT Silchar, which is www.nits.ac.in.

faq.question: Q10. Does NIT Silchar offer any age relaxation for specific categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation will be provided to SC/ST/OBC/WOMEN/PWD candidates as per the rules and regulations of the Government of India.
